prompt_en: Build a single Date Picker, not a full page. Structure: an input showing the selected date; opening it reveals a month calendar grid with weekday headers, prev/next month arrows, and today outlined. Interaction: click a day to select and close, arrows change months, today is highlighted. States: empty, filled, panel open, selected day, disabled past days optional. Motion: 150ms panel fade. Do not use a native date input. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个日期选择器，不是整页。结构：输入框显示所选日期，展开后为月历网格：星期表头、上/下月箭头、今天描边高亮。交互：点某天选中并关闭，箭头切月，今天高亮。状态：空、已填、面板展开、已选日期、过去日期可选禁用。动效：面板 150ms 淡入。不要用原生 date input。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 页面常驻的日历视图，无输入框
prompt_en: Build a single Inline Calendar, not a full page. Structure: an always-visible month grid (7 columns) with month title and prev/next arrows at top; today outlined, selected day filled. Interaction: click days to select, arrows navigate months, selection persists across month changes. States: today, selected, other-month days muted, hover. Motion: 120ms selection transition. Do not wrap it in an input. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个内嵌日历，不是整页。结构：常驻显示的月历网格（7 列），顶部月份标题与前后翻月箭头；今天描边、已选日期填充。交互：点选日期、箭头翻月、跨月后选中态保留。状态：今天、已选、非本月日期置灰、悬停。动效：选中 120ms 过渡。不要包在输入框里。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 选起止日期，如预订区间
prompt_en: Build a single Date Range Picker, not a full page. Structure: an input showing start-end; the panel shows one or two month grids where clicking sets start then end, and days between them are tinted. Interaction: first click sets start, second sets end, a third click restarts; range tint follows hover for the pending end. States: empty, start-only, complete range, hover preview. Motion: 120ms tint updates. Do not select two unrelated dates. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个日期范围选择器，不是整页。结构：输入框显示起-止；面板为一到两个月历，第一次点击设起点、第二次设终点，两点之间着色。交互：第三次点击重新开始；待选终点悬停时范围预览着色。状态：空、只有起点、范围完整、悬停预览。动效：着色 120ms 更新。不允许选出两个不相关日期。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

prompt_en: Build a single Time Picker, not a full page. Structure: an input showing HH:mm; opening it shows scrollable columns of hours and minutes (or a compact list) with the current value highlighted. Interaction: pick hour then minute, click outside closes, typed input parses on blur. States: empty, filled, panel open, option highlighted. Motion: 150ms panel fade. Do not use a native time input. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个时间选择器，不是整页。结构：输入框显示 HH:mm，展开后为可滚动的时/分两列（或紧凑列表），当前值高亮。交互：先选时再选分，点外关闭，手动输入失焦解析。状态：空、已填、面板展开、选项高亮。动效：面板 150ms 淡入。不要用原生 time input。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

prompt_en: Build a single Datetime Picker, not a full page. Structure: one input for date and time; the panel combines a month grid with a time row (hour/minute steppers or selects) and an OK button. Interaction: pick a day, adjust time, OK confirms and closes. States: empty, filled, panel open, confirm disabled until a day is chosen. Motion: 150ms panel fade. Do not use two separate widgets. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个日期时间选择器，不是整页。结构：一个输入框承载日期与时间；面板把月历和时间行（时/分步进器或下拉）组合，带确定按钮。交互：选日、调时间、确定后关闭。状态：空、已填、面板展开、未选日时确定禁用。动效：面板 150ms 淡入。不要拆成两个独立控件。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 只精确到月的场景，如账单月
prompt_en: Build a single Month Picker, not a full page. Structure: an input showing YYYY-MM; the panel shows a year title with arrows and a 4x3 grid of months. Interaction: click a month to select and close, arrows change the year. States: empty, filled, panel open, current month outlined, selected filled. Motion: 150ms panel fade. Do not show day-level granularity. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个月份选择器，不是整页。结构：输入框显示 YYYY-MM，面板顶部年份标题带箭头，下方 4x3 月份网格。交互：点某月选中并关闭，箭头切年。状态：空、已填、面板展开、当前月描边、已选填充。动效：面板 150ms 淡入。不要出现日粒度。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 近 7 天/近 30 天这类快捷区间
prompt_en: Build a single Relative Time Input, not a full page. Structure: a row of quick-range chips (Today, Last 7 days, Last 30 days, Custom) plus a readout of the resolved absolute range beneath. Interaction: click a chip to select it and update the readout; Custom chip enables two small date inputs. States: chip default/selected, custom inputs enabled. Motion: 120ms chip highlight. Do not open a full calendar for preset chips. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个相对时间输入，不是整页。结构：一排快捷区间 chip（今天、近 7 天、近 30 天、自定义）+ 下方解析出的绝对区间读数。交互：点 chip 选中并更新读数；自定义 chip 启用两个小日期输入。状态：chip 默认/选中、自定义输入启用。动效：120ms chip 高亮。预设 chip 不要弹完整日历。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 秒杀/截止时间的倒计时展示
prompt_en: Build a single Countdown display, not a full page. Structure: three boxed segments (hours, minutes, seconds) with colons between, ticking down every second from a demo start value. Interaction: none required; restarts automatically after reaching zero. States: ticking, final-10-seconds (danger color), zero. Motion: digit flip or fade 200ms per second. Do not build a settable timer UI. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个倒计时显示，不是整页。结构：时/分/秒三个盒子段用冒号相连，从演示初值每秒递减。交互：可无；归零后自动重开。状态：计时中、最后 10 秒（危险色）、归零。动效：每秒数字翻转或淡入 200ms。不要做成可设置时间的计时器界面。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 预约类场景选可约时段
prompt_en: Build a single Time Slot Picker, not a full page. Structure: a grid of time-slot chips (e.g. 09:00-10:00 etc.), some slots disabled as booked. Interaction: click an available slot to single-select it. States: available, selected (filled), disabled/booked, hover. Motion: 120ms selection. Do not allow selecting multiple slots. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个时段选择器，不是整页。结构：时段 chip 网格（如 09:00-10:00 等），部分已约满禁用。交互：点可用时段单选。状态：可选、已选（填充）、禁用/已约、悬停。动效：120ms 选中过渡。不允许多选时段。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 按周选择的场景，如周报
prompt_en: Build a single Week Picker, not a full page. Structure: a month calendar where hovering highlights the entire row (week) and clicking selects the whole week; the input shows the week range. Interaction: hover previews the week tint, click selects all seven days. States: row hover, week selected, today. Motion: 120ms row tint. Do not allow single-day selection. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个周选择器，不是整页。结构：月历中悬停高亮整行（一周），点击选中整周；输入框显示该周区间。交互：悬停预览行着色，点击选中七天。状态：行悬停、整周已选、今天。动效：120ms 行着色。不允许只选单日。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。
